who.value: seller hosting a Live show (or a viewer sharing it)

job.value: Share the show (or an item in it) to a social app

arrivedFrom.value: A Share button in the live show, Shop or My Shows

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Share this show' with a show card and a grid of social apps makes the purpose plain.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The share-target grid is the main body of the sheet, directly under the card.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: App targets are clear, but 'Download' and 'Copy link' don't say whether they act on the image or the show link.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'IG-Feed', 'IG-Stories', 'FB-Feed' and 'FB-Stories' are clipped internal-style abbreviations rather than the apps' own names.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The only choice is where to share, which the user knows.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Less common targets are behind 'More'; other cards only peek at the right edge.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is for sharing this show.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Icons and app names carry the screen; there is no explanatory text.
